purpose: Stage and independently review only inert binding of already-verified Local Mistral model/server descriptors to inherited /proc/self/fd runtime identities.
baseDependency: PR #5324 conversion-root authority must be admitted before this stacked segment is eligible to merge.
requiredInvariants: This PR remains inert: it does not launch llama-server, invoke Mistral, publish provider status, change workflow routing, or change product/API/database/RBAC/registration/cabinet behavior.
Inputs must already be VerifiedReadableFile-like authorities from the admitted content-verification layer and must expose fd, sha256, size, dev and ino fields.
The caller-supplied expected SHA-256 and exact sizes must exactly equal the previously verified object values before any runtime binding is created.
The source descriptors and their duplicates must fstat as regular files owned by uid 0, have zero user/group/world write bits, and retain the admitted device/inode/size identity.
The llama-server descriptor must have at least one execute bit; the GGUF model descriptor is not required to be executable.
Runtime-owned descriptors are created only with os.dup from the already-verified readable descriptors; no original filesystem pathname is opened or reconstructed.
Derived runtime paths are exactly /proc/self/fd/<integer-fd> for those owned duplicate descriptors and are never accepted from caller input.
Returned runtime descriptors are non-inheritable by default; a later separately reviewed launcher may inherit only the explicit pass_fds tuple.
The helper exposes no process-launch, network, token, prompt, model-response or attestation behavior.
Local Qwen remains the independent reviewer for this future Local Mistral authority change.
REG.RU remains production authority, mandatory SaaS/API keys remain none and new recurring cost remains 0 RUB.
